claim: Read the main decoder upward from the embedding stream. Images enter through MoonViT-V2 and an MLP into that stream. The depicted repeated block contains three KDA/expert pairs and one gated MLA/expert pair. Red paths retrieve representations from earlier depth blocks and embeddings using learned mixing; they are not arrows to prior token positions. The upper-left Stable LatentMoE inset keeps two full-width shared branches, projects the routed branch to narrower latent space, selects experts there, normalizes their aggregate, and projects it back. The lower-left KDA inset derives normalized queries and keys through linear projections and local convolutions, derives values separately, supplies retention and write gates to KDA, and uses a gated normalized readout before the output projection. The configuration supplies the concrete 69 KDA and 24 MLA layer count separately.
